mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.0% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0% for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint decline of HOUST and RSAFS shows no negative correlation with SPX 20-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO decline > 0.5% in 3 months) reduces corporate production capacity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days due to earnings pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when INDPRO declines > 0.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained retail sales growth above 0.5% monthly (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through near-term earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS growth exceeds 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers anticipated monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent unemployment rate increase and non-farm payrolls decline (UNRATE rise and PAYEMS fall) indicates labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days through reduced consumer income.
failure_condition: The joint condition of UNRATE rise and PAYEMS decline shows no negative correlation with SPX 20-day returns (p > 0.05) in rolling 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion regime (GDP growth > 2.5% and unemployment < 5.0%) drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days through sustained corporate earnings momentum and investor confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of periods when GDPC1 > 2.5% and UNRATE < 5.0%.
